entries.label: Enable Cyrus Scatter
entries.description: Enables calculation and output for this setup. Turn it off to disable the setup as a whole. Use Show preview instead when you only want to hide its viewport display.

entries.label: Viewport update
entries.description: Keeps the last completed planting while you adjust settings. Press Update now when ready to calculate the changes. A visible old result is not proof that the new values have been applied.

entries.label: Update now
entries.description: Explicitly calculates the enabled layers and sets in order. Use it after edits in Manual or when deliberately requesting a fresh result.

entries.label: Show preview
entries.description: Shows or hides the setup's viewport preview. It keeps the setup enabled and does not act as a render-disable switch.

entries.label: Display mode
entries.description: Draws samples of the source shapes. The usual starting choice for browsing larger plantings.

entries.label: Proxy shape
entries.description: Chooses Box, Sphere or Pyramid in Proxy mode. Box is the starting choice.

entries.label: Instances/layer
entries.description: Limits displayed instances in geometry-preview modes. Starts at 2,000; allows 1–100,000. It does not set the number of generated plants.

entries.label: Faces/layer
entries.description: Limits geometry-preview complexity. Starts at 2,000,000; allows 12–20,000,000. A dense source model can exhaust the budget with relatively few plants.

entries.label: Preview color
entries.description: Uses one chosen preview color.

entries.label: Solid
entries.description: Picks the color used in Solid Color mode.

entries.label: Point limit
entries.description: Overall point-preview budget, shared among enabled populations. Starts at 20,000; allows 1,000–500,000.

entries.label: Points/plant
entries.description: Requested shape samples per plant in Point Cloud. Starts at 80; allows 10–10,000. The point budget may reduce how much can be shown. It is not needed for one-marker Plant centres.

entries.label: Radii / layer
entries.description: Limits the number of enabled source-radius guides displayed. Starts at 2,000. Zero hides those guides when the limit is in use.

entries.label: Show All Radii
entries.description: Bypasses that radius-guide count limit. Individual sources still need Show Radius enabled. Starts off.

entries.label: Icon size
entries.description: Size of the Scatter scene icon, in scene units. Default 10. It does not scale plants or their radii.

entries.label: Refresh preview
entries.description: Explicitly updates the preview. This can also apply pending recipe edits; do not use it as a passive statistics-reading action.

entries.label: Automatic final render
entries.description: Prepares the Scatter's full accepted model output for rendering. Starts on. Point Cloud markers are not the final render geometry.

entries.label: Remove old baked output
entries.description: Removes output objects owned as baked output by this Scatter. It does not mean remove the original source models.

entries.label: Pick receiving surface
entries.description: Click, then pick the ground mesh. This replaces the current receiving-surface selection with that one surface.

entries.label: Receiving surfaces...
entries.description: Choose one or several receiving surfaces by name. Confirm the selection to use that list. Ordinary scattering can use multiple surfaces; Brush requires exactly one shared surface.

entries.label: Global source containers — now opened through Advanced
entries.description: Select a shared source rectangle. These rectangles are available to sets that explicitly choose Global containers. Creating one does not automatically change every set's source pool.

entries.label: Global source containers
entries.description: Select a shared source rectangle. These rectangles are available to sets that explicitly choose Global containers. Creating one does not automatically change every set's source pool.

entries.label: Create source rectangle
entries.description: Creates a shared source container in the scene. Place original model pivots inside it.

entries.label: Pick source rectangle
entries.description: Links a suitable existing source container to this setup's global pool.

entries.label: Unlink selected rectangle
entries.description: Removes the link to this pool. It keeps the rectangle, scene models and registered source settings.

entries.label: Layer list
entries.description: Selects the layer edited by the sections below. Each row shows its name, placed count and result status. Double-clicking can open its optional editor.

entries.label: Edit layer in window...
entries.description: Opens an optional floating view of the same settings. It does not create another layer or a second independent planting.

entries.label: Add
entries.description: Creates a layer with a Base set. An empty layer still needs a receiving surface and useful sources before it can produce planting.

entries.label: Copy
entries.description: Copies the selected layer and its paint sets/settings. The new layer is independent; it can still refer to the same original scene models or shared source containers.

entries.label: Remove
entries.description: Removes the selected layer and its sets. If it still owns baked output, clear that output first. This is more destructive than turning Enabled off.

entries.label: Name
entries.description: Renames the selected layer. It keeps that layer's saved relationships.

entries.label: Visible
entries.description: Controls the layer's viewport display. An invisible but enabled layer still participates in spacing and can appear in final output.

entries.label: Enabled
entries.description: Includes the layer in calculation and final output. Disabling it also takes its sets out of that calculation.

entries.label: Move up
entries.description: Changes calculation order. Earlier layers normally get space first when a between-layer spacing rule applies. These buttons do not move scene objects.

entries.label: Move down
entries.description: Changes calculation order. Earlier layers normally get space first when a between-layer spacing rule applies. These buttons do not move scene objects.

entries.label: Start recording
entries.description: Starts a short record of plugin activity. A new recording replaces the previous recording, so save the previous one first if needed.

entries.label: Stop
entries.description: Stops recording and keeps the collected history available for saving.

entries.label: Save report...
entries.description: Choose where to save the report. Saving stops recording and writes the retained history. It does not upload it.

entries.label: Read recording status
entries.description: Reads recorder state without calculating the scene. The displayed state is read on request rather than continuously refreshed.

entries.label: Update setup
entries.description: Updates the entire setup, including enabled layers and sets in order. It is not limited to the current tab.

entries.label: Layer dropdown
entries.description: Changes the layer being edited.

entries.label: Paint set dropdown
entries.description: Changes the set-specific models, coverage and related values.

entries.label: Assets
entries.description: Shows Models & source containers and paint-set management. Source assignment is under the Models section's Advanced controls.

entries.label: Population
entries.description: Shows Population and Include / exclude areas.

entries.label: Paint
entries.description: Shows Coverage & painting, including background controls in Advanced.

entries.label: Transform
entries.description: Shows layer transforms. An older tooltip may still mention source assignment; find assignment under Assets in the current layout.

entries.label: Spacing
entries.description: Shows spacing rules, individual radii, Relax and cleanup.

entries.label: Statistics
entries.description: Shows result information and the current statistics/diagnostic section.

entries.label: Refresh fields
entries.description: Rereads settings and existing counts without requesting new planting. Use it to refresh the editing view.

entries.label: Selected paint set
entries.description: Chooses which set's models, coverage, background and source-specific values you edit. Layer-wide controls continue to affect the whole layer.

entries.label: Add set
entries.description: Adds another set within this layer. New additional sets begin with painted coverage, initially empty when a valid single receiver is available. Paint or Fill it, or choose whole-surface coverage.

entries.label: Remove
entries.description: Removes the selected additional set. The Base set cannot be removed separately; disable it or change its coverage instead.

entries.label: Name
entries.description: Renames the selected paint set without discarding its saved settings.

entries.label: Share weight
entries.description: Divides the layer population between enabled sets. It is relative, not a plant count. Two sets with weights 1 and 3 receive roughly one quarter and three quarters of the requested layer population before rejection. Zero gives no ordinary population share.

entries.label: Enabled
entries.description: Includes this set in calculation and output.

entries.label: Visible
entries.description: Hides or shows this set in the viewport; it still participates in calculation and output while enabled.

entries.label: Move up
entries.description: Changes set order inside this layer. Background references must remain earlier than the set using them, so some moves are refused.

entries.label: Move down
entries.description: Changes set order inside this layer. Background references must remain earlier than the set using them, so some moves are refused.

entries.label: Sources list (Ctrl/Shift)
entries.description: Shows the registered models or placeholders, their weight and color group. Highlight the rows you intend to edit.

entries.label: Choose from list...
entries.description: Adds one or several models by name instead of picking in the viewport.

entries.label: Pick model
entries.description: Picks one scene model for this set. The layer editor stays on its current layer while you choose a model.

entries.label: Add selected
entries.description: Adds the scene objects already selected in Max.

entries.label: Remove rows
entries.description: Removes the highlighted registered sources and their row settings. The original scene models remain.

entries.label: Select sources
entries.description: Selects the highlighted source models in the scene.

entries.label: Add Point
entries.description: Adds a placement placeholder. A Point can count as an accepted placeholder without providing final model geometry.

entries.label: Add Empty
entries.description: Adds a weighted intentional gap. Use Candidate budget population for positive-weight Empty rows.

entries.label: Replace Point: pick object
entries.description: Select exactly one Point row, then pick its replacement model. This keeps a placeholder workflow without adding another unrelated source row.

entries.label: Existing color groups
entries.description: Assigns highlighted sources to a previously used group. The group's color identifies a family for clustering and pattern assignment.

entries.label: Color
entries.description: Chooses a color group for highlighted sources. Accepting the color applies it. This is not a material-color editor.

entries.label: Apply to selected rows
entries.description: Applies the chosen color group to all highlighted source rows.

entries.label: Weight
entries.description: Relative chance of choosing this model within the set. Range 0–1; 0 disables that source. Weights do not have to add to 1. Values 1 and 0.5 mean roughly twice as much of the first model before other restrictions.

entries.label: Z Offset
entries.description: Raises or lowers instances along their placement normal. Default 0. Use it to correct a model that appears buried or floating.

entries.label: Scale
entries.description: Multiplies the size of instances made from the selected model. Default 1; 0.5 halves size. It works together with layer scale and any boundary/band scale.

entries.label: Radius
entries.description: The selected model's collision footprint, in scene units. Default 0. It does not measure the mesh automatically. Give it a useful positive value when spacing should account for plant size.

entries.label: Follow Scale
entries.description: Makes the collision footprint respond to instance scale. Without it, the source radius remains a fixed distance. Starts off.

entries.label: Show Radius
entries.description: Displays this source's collision-radius guides. It does not turn spacing on. Viewport radius limits may show only some guides. Starts off.

entries.label: Forward axis
entries.description: Chooses +Y, -Y, +X or -X as the model's forward direction for orientation. Use it when a path-facing model points sideways or backwards.

entries.label: Point / Empty sources and color groups — now under Advanced
entries.description: Adds a placement placeholder. A Point can count as an accepted placeholder without providing final model geometry.

entries.label: Source pool
entries.description: Use models added directly to this paint set's source list. The rectangle list is empty unless a container pool is selected. Create and Pick are still available and switch to an own container pool.

entries.label: Rectangles
entries.description: Selects a linked rectangle for unlinking or inspection.

entries.label: Create
entries.description: Creates a source container owned by this layer/Base or this additional set, and switches to that own pool. To create a shared global rectangle, use Receiving surfaces > Advanced instead.

entries.label: Pick
entries.description: Links an existing Cyrus container to this owner's pool and switches to that pool. Picking a suitable square-corner Rectangle creates a Cyrus container from it and keeps the original spline.

entries.label: Unlink
entries.description: Removes the selected rectangle from this owner's pool without deleting it or the original models. It is unavailable while using an inherited/global pool; edit that pool at its owner instead.

entries.label: Method
entries.description: Samples the receiving surfaces without a texture-density mask.

entries.label: Population
entries.description: Requests a fixed layer amount. Useful when you want a predictable starting budget.

entries.label: Requested count
entries.description: Starts at 200; range 1–100,000. Restrictions can reduce the final result.

entries.label: Per m2
entries.description: Plants per square metre, regardless of the scene's display units. Starts at 100. The population request is capped at 100,000. Painted coverage and exclusions do not promise to preserve that number inside a smaller area.

entries.label: Seed
entries.description: Changes the initial random layout. The first layer starts at 42; later new layers receive different starting seeds. Use a non-negative whole number and keep it fixed when comparing other settings. Changing it can require resetting individual CS Edit changes.

entries.label: Choose density map
entries.description: Selects the map. White permits planting; black excludes it; intermediate values thin the planting. It reads the receiver's UV channel 1.

entries.label: Invert density
entries.description: Reverses the map's light/dark permission. Starts off.

entries.label: Layer population
entries.description: The default. Tries the generated population once; rejected plants leave a lower final count. Use it for predictable work and intentional Empty-source gaps.

entries.label: Attempt factor
entries.description: Limits how many candidates can be tried as a multiple of the request. Default 8; range 1–32. Higher values may help fill difficult areas but cost more work.

entries.label: Max rounds
entries.description: Limits repeated passes. Default 8; range 1–16. It is not an animation or display refresh setting.

entries.label: Retry cleanup gaps
entries.description: Allows bounded attempts to replace plants removed by final cleanup. Starts on, but matters when Accepted target is selected.

entries.label: Closed lines / shapes
entries.description: Selects linked area shapes. Rows show whether each is Include or Exclude.

entries.label: Select From Scene...
entries.description: Links suitable closed shapes by name.

entries.label: Add: pick closed line
entries.description: Links a suitable closed shape from the viewport.

entries.label: Remove selected rows
entries.description: Unlinks the selected area shapes and their falloff settings. It keeps the scene splines.

entries.label: Selected area mode
entries.description: Permits planting inside the selected shapes. Multiple include shapes form the allowed areas.

entries.label: Refresh areas / preview
entries.description: Explicitly refreshes area information and requests a preview update. Use this as an update action, not as passive inspection.

entries.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
entries.description: Links an existing Analyzer to the layer's area mask. This link is separate from the Analyzer used for source assignment or boundary falloff.

entries.label: Remove Area Analyzer
entries.description: Unlinks this area-mask Analyzer and turns off its line/point masks.

entries.label: Center Line
entries.description: Uses a band around the Analyzer's central path as an allowed area.

entries.label: Full width
entries.description: Total width of that band, not the width on each side.

entries.label: Line ends
entries.description: Chooses the shape of the band's end caps.

entries.label: Street offset
entries.description: Moves the center-line mask sideways. It shares the layer offset used by Centerline source assignment.

entries.label: Points
entries.description: Uses discs around Analyzer sample points as allowed areas.

entries.label: Radius
entries.description: Radius of those discs. This is an area-mask radius, not a model collision radius.

entries.label: Edge falloff target
entries.description: Edits the boundary effects driven by the falloff Analyzer.

entries.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
entries.description: In Analyzer Boundary mode, links the Analyzer whose boundary drives the falloff.

entries.label: Remove Analyzer
entries.description: Removes that falloff link and disables its boundary effects. It does not delete the Analyzer.

entries.label: Delete edge band
entries.description: Removes planting in a strip beside the boundary. Starts off.

entries.label: Delete width
entries.description: Width of that removed strip. Default 0.

entries.label: Scale ramp
entries.description: Changes plant size progressively with distance from the boundary. Starts off.

entries.label: Scale width
entries.description: Distance over which the scale curve is applied. Default 100 scene units.

entries.label: Edit Scale Graph...
entries.description: Opens the shape of the scale transition.

entries.label: Density ramp
entries.description: Changes how much planting is permitted as distance from the boundary increases. Starts off.

entries.label: Density width
entries.description: Distance over which the density curve is applied. Default 100 scene units.

entries.label: Edit Density Graph...
entries.description: Opens the shape of the density transition.

entries.label: Analyzer and falloff details — now under Advanced
entries.description: Explicitly refreshes area information and requests a preview update. Use this as an update action, not as passive inspection.

entries.label: Coverage
entries.description: Lets this set use the receiver subject to its other restrictions. Saved paint is retained when you stop using it.

entries.label: Next stroke
entries.description: Paint adds permission; Erase removes it. This changes the next stroke, not every saved stroke.

entries.label: Radius
entries.description: The next stroke's size in scene units. A larger value covers more ground. Initial tool value is 20.

entries.label: Strength %
entries.description: How strongly the next stroke paints or erases, from 0–100%. Initial value 100%.

entries.label: Softness %
entries.description: Softens the next stroke's edge. Range 0–100%; initial tool value 50%.

entries.label: Mask %
entries.description: Thins plants permitted by the coverage. Range 0–100%; starts at 100%. This is separate from the layer's absolute population.

entries.label: Start Brush
entries.description: Begins painting on the selected set's receiver and creates empty coverage if needed.

entries.label: Stop
entries.description: Finishes the active Brush interaction and keeps its stroke history. Stop before switching context or using unrelated scene tools.

entries.label: Fill
entries.description: Fills the coverage and resets the stroke history. Use Undo to recover the previous coverage if this was accidental. Other area and spacing restrictions still apply.

entries.label: Empty
entries.description: Empties the coverage and resets its stroke history. It does not delete the source models.

entries.label: Paint feedback
entries.description: Shows sampled coverage feedback; this is the starting feedback mode.

entries.label: Color
entries.description: Changes the coverage guide's color for this set. It does not recolor model materials.

entries.label: Group stroke history
entries.description: The selected paint set's saved-stroke list. Select a stroke to edit it. Order matters when later strokes paint over or erase earlier ones. “Group” here refers to this set, not a Max object group.

entries.label: Enabled
entries.description: Enables or disables the selected saved stroke without deleting it.

entries.label: Erase
entries.description: Changes the selected saved stroke between adding and removing coverage.

entries.label: Saved stroke Radius
entries.description: Changes the selected stroke's width along its existing path.

entries.label: Saved stroke Strength
entries.description: Changes that stroke's contribution to coverage.

entries.label: Saved stroke Softness
entries.description: Changes that stroke's edge.

entries.label: Delete selected stroke
entries.description: Removes the selected stroke. Undo can restore it.

entries.label: Reset coverage target...
entries.description: After confirmation, replaces this set's paint with empty coverage on the current receiver. Use it deliberately when changing the painted surface.

entries.label: Brush feedback and history — now under Advanced
entries.description: Softens the next stroke's edge. Range 0–100%; initial tool value 50%.

entries.label: This set: background
entries.description: No special background relationship. Ordinary area, coverage and spacing rules still apply.

entries.label: Earlier paint sets
entries.description: Selects which preceding sets this background relationship refers to. Select at least one for an active background mode.

entries.label: Apply background
entries.description: Saves the chosen mode and references together. Unlike automatic spacing fields, this section has an explicit Apply button.

entries.label: Rotation X min
entries.description: Adds tilt around the placement's X axis. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Rotation X max
entries.description: Adds tilt around the placement's X axis. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Rotation Y min
entries.description: Adds tilt around the placement's Y axis. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Rotation Y max
entries.description: Adds tilt around the placement's Y axis. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Rotation Z min
entries.description: Random turning around the placement's upright direction, in degrees. New layers start at 0–360 for varied facing. Set both to the same value for consistent facing.

entries.label: Rotation Z max
entries.description: Random turning around the placement's upright direction, in degrees. New layers start at 0–360 for varied facing. Set both to the same value for consistent facing.

entries.label: Scale X min
entries.description: Changes size independently along X. Both start at 1.

entries.label: Scale X max
entries.description: Changes size independently along X. Both start at 1.

entries.label: Scale Y min
entries.description: Changes size independently along Y. Both start at 1.

entries.label: Scale Y max
entries.description: Changes size independently along Y. Both start at 1.

entries.label: Scale Z min
entries.description: Changes size independently along Z. Both start at 1. Useful for height variation, but can stretch the model.

entries.label: Scale Z max
entries.description: Changes size independently along Z. Both start at 1. Useful for height variation, but can stretch the model.

entries.label: Whole scale min
entries.description: Uniform size multiplier that preserves a model's proportions. Both start at 1. Use 0.8–1.2 for modest size variation.

entries.label: Whole scale max
entries.description: Uniform size multiplier that preserves a model's proportions. Both start at 1. Use 0.8–1.2 for modest size variation.

entries.label: Movement X min
entries.description: Adds random offset along X, in scene units. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Movement X max
entries.description: Adds random offset along X, in scene units. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Movement Y min
entries.description: Adds random offset along Y. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Movement Y max
entries.description: Adds random offset along Y. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Movement Z min
entries.description: Adds random offset along Z. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Movement Z max
entries.description: Adds random offset along Z. Both start at 0.

entries.label: Keep on surface
entries.description: Projects random movement back onto the receiver. Starts on. Turning it off can allow moved candidates away from the surface and conflicts with some coverage workflows.

entries.label: Align to normal
entries.description: Tilts a plant's upright direction to match the receiving surface. Starts on. Turn it off when plants should remain upright independently of ground slope.

entries.label: Reset rotation
entries.description: Sets every random rotation limit to 0, including Z. This removes rotation variation; it does not restore the new-layer 0–360 Z range.

entries.label: Reset XYZ scale
entries.description: Sets all separate-axis scale limits to 1. Keeps the whole-scale setting.

entries.label: Reset whole scale
entries.description: Sets the uniform scale limits to 1. Keeps the separate-axis scale settings.

entries.label: Reset movement
entries.description: Sets the movement limits to 0. It does not reset rotation, scale or individual CS Edit changes.

entries.label: Source assignment
entries.description: Choose among available models using their source weights. This is the simplest starting point.

entries.label: Size
entries.description: Spatial size of the color-group patches. Larger values make broader patches.

entries.label: Seed
entries.description: Changes the assignment pattern. This is separate from Population > Seed, which changes the initial planting layout. Default 42.

entries.label: Roughness %
entries.description: Adds irregularity to the cluster pattern. Starts at 0.

entries.label: Blur edge %
entries.description: Mixes source groups around cluster transitions. Starts at 0.

entries.label: Noise %
entries.description: Introduces more scattered variation in group selection. Starts at 0.

entries.label: Paths
entries.description: Selects the linked closed line whose bands you are editing.

entries.label: Analyzer data
entries.description: Uses the analyzed boundary for inward bands. Add Stroke Inside creates a band.

entries.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
entries.description: Pick Surface Analyzer links an existing Analyzer. Analyzer data selects which result you are using:

entries.label: Add: pick closed line
entries.description: Links a suitable closed spline. It does not turn that spline into the ground surface.

entries.label: Remove path
entries.description: Unlinks the selected path and its related assignment settings, keeping the original scene spline. In Analyzer mode the caption becomes Remove Analyzer.

entries.label: Consecutive strokes
entries.description: Selects one assignment band or row to edit. These are pattern bands, separate from the freehand Brush history.

entries.label: Add Outside
entries.description: Adds a band on the corresponding side of the selected closed line. Consecutive widths build outward or inward from that boundary.

entries.label: Add Inside
entries.description: Adds a band on the corresponding side of the selected closed line. Consecutive widths build outward or inward from that boundary.

entries.label: Remove Stroke
entries.description: Removes the selected assignment band and its settings.

entries.label: Width
entries.description: Sets the selected band's thickness. The meaning changes to Spacing for an Edge Border row.

entries.label: Assign by
entries.description: Lets the band use models from selected color groups.

entries.label: Source/group choices (Ctrl/Shift)
entries.description: Select the models or groups allowed for this band. Choices must exist in the paint set being used.

entries.label: Scale min
entries.description: Adds a size range for this band. Both start at 1. The values combine with source and layer scale.

entries.label: Scale max
entries.description: Adds a size range for this band. Both start at 1. The values combine with source and layer scale.

entries.label: Refresh sources / groups
entries.description: Refreshes the choices after editing your source list or groups. It is not the setup's Update now button.

entries.label: Offset inward
entries.description: Edge Border. Moves the selected row inward from the edge; a negative value goes the other way.

entries.label: Jitter along
entries.description: Edge Border. Allows variation along the row direction. Zero leaves it regular.

entries.label: Jitter across
entries.description: Edge Border. Allows sideways variation from the row. Zero keeps that part regular.

entries.label: Keep corner points
entries.description: Edge Border. Adds corner-preserving positions when a turn meets the chosen threshold.

entries.label: Min turn
entries.description: The smallest corner angle to preserve, in degrees. Default 45; available when Keep corner points is on.

entries.label: Points/corner
entries.description: How many corner positions to request. Default 1; allowed values 1–64.

entries.label: Local X (deg)
entries.description: Additional rotation of models in the selected Edge Border row. Each starts at 0.

entries.label: Local Y (deg)
entries.description: Additional rotation of models in the selected Edge Border row. Each starts at 0.

entries.label: Local Z (deg)
entries.description: Additional rotation of models in the selected Edge Border row. Each starts at 0.

entries.label: Trim start
entries.description: Street Side. Leaves a distance unplanted at each end of the selected street-facing guide. Starts at 0.

entries.label: Trim end
entries.description: Street Side. Leaves a distance unplanted at each end of the selected street-facing guide. Starts at 0.

entries.label: Street offset
entries.description: Centerline. Moves the guide sideways by a signed distance. It is the same layer offset also exposed by the Analyzer Area controls.

entries.label: Face outward
entries.description: Border, Street Side and Edge Border. Orients models outward relative to the boundary. Check the source's Forward axis if the model faces the wrong way.

entries.label: Corner radius
entries.description: Smooths changes of facing direction around corners when Face outward is on. Edge Border calls this Blend radius. It is not a collision radius or a rounded rectangle edit.

entries.label: Straight ends (Street Side)
entries.description: Uses straight-ended treatment for that street-side pattern.

entries.label: Spacing scope
entries.description: Separates ordinary plants within the selected set. Initially follows the layer's within-set default. Editing these values gives this set its own rule.

entries.label: Other owner
entries.description: Selects the other set or layer for a pair rule. It is unavailable for a default or within-set rule.

entries.label: Enable this spacing
entries.description: Turns on this particular rule. New layer defaults start off.

entries.label: Radius factor
entries.description: Multiplies the combined collision radii of the two plants. Default 1. Larger values leave more room.

entries.label: Extra gap
entries.description: Adds a fixed clearance after the radii. Default 0, in scene units. Useful even when source radii are zero.

entries.label: XY distance (off = 3D)
entries.description: On measures top-down separation and ignores height. Off measures full spatial distance, so plants at different heights can have more room. Default is off for a fresh rule.

entries.label: Use inherited / default
entries.description: Use inherited / default removes a selected set override or pair override. A set returns to its layer's within-set default; a set pair returns to the between-set default. A layer pair without a rule has no between-layer separation. On a default scope, this button resets that default to disabled, factor 1 and gap 0.

entries.label: Selected CS Edit instances
entries.description: Explains the current edit selection and whether an override can be applied.

entries.label: Value
entries.description: The radius or multiplier to apply. Entering it alone does not apply anything.

entries.label: Set selected radii
entries.description: Applies the chosen mode and value to the selected instances. Requires a valid CS Edit selection in this set.

entries.label: Clear selected overrides
entries.description: Returns selected instances to their inherited source radii.

entries.label: Clear this set's overrides
entries.description: Removes every individual radius override belonging to the current paint set.

entries.label: Point Relax
entries.description: Tries to spread nearby proposed positions more evenly. Starts off.

entries.label: Desired spacing
entries.description: The separation it tries to improve toward. Initial value 0.2 scene units; this is not a final guarantee.

entries.label: Iterations
entries.description: Number of adjustment steps, 1–100; default 10. More steps can cost more time.

entries.label: Strength %
entries.description: Size of each adjustment, 0–100%; default 50%.

entries.label: Boundary Relax
entries.description: Smooths neighboring proposed positions with limited movement. Starts off. It does not reshape the receiving mesh or Area splines.

entries.label: Boundary Relax: Strength
entries.description: Boundary Relax strength from 0–1; default 0.3.

entries.label: Boundary Relax: Iterations
entries.description: Boundary Relax steps, 0–100; default 5.

entries.label: Boundary Relax: Max movement
entries.description: Limits how far Boundary Relax may move a position. Default 10 scene units.

entries.label: Remove isolated plants
entries.description: Enables cleanup. Starts off.

entries.label: Neighbor distance
entries.description: Distance within which plants count as neighbors. Default 100 scene units.

entries.label: Minimum neighbors
entries.description: Removes unprotected plants that have too few neighbors. Default 2. A value of 0 removes this neighbor-count requirement.

entries.label: Minimum island size
entries.description: Removes unprotected connected patches that are too small. Default 5. Zero removes this patch-size requirement.

entries.label: XY neighborhoods (off = 3D)
entries.description: Chooses top-down or full spatial neighbor measurement. Starts on. This choice is separate from the spacing rule's XY checkbox.

entries.label: Read cached statistics
entries.description: Reads the existing result without requesting new planting. Use this when checking what already happened.

entries.label: Layer / display help
entries.description: Opens an explanation of settings ownership, order, display budgets and limits. It does not change the scene.

entries.label: Edit linked Scatter context
entries.description: Chooses which linked setup/layer/set to edit if more than one uses this rectangle. Changing this view does not change the rectangle's membership.

entries.label: Width
entries.description: Resizes the rectangle. Starting dimensions are 500 by 300 scene units. Models keep their transforms; a changed boundary can admit or park them.

entries.label: Length
entries.description: Resizes the rectangle. Starting dimensions are 500 by 300 scene units. Models keep their transforms; a changed boundary can admit or park them.

entries.label: Show viewport label
entries.description: Shows or hides the rectangle's context and active/saved counts beside it.

entries.label: Active / parked source models
entries.description: Shows models retained for this container and their current state. Select a row before assigning movement ownership.

entries.label: Follow this container
entries.description: Assigns the selected source's movement following to this container. Use it to resolve overlapping rectangles. The model can still be used by other sets.

entries.label: Edit layer...
entries.description: Opens the optional window for the currently linked layer.
